I can't tell you whether that's safe or give you an amount. That one is for a doctor or a dietitian, who can look at your health and what's in those products. In general, pre-workouts are built around stimulants like caffeine, and different brands stack different things, so doubling up means you can't easily tell what you're taking in total. If you want a boost before training, sleep, a proper meal beforehand and a good warm-up do more than most scoops.
